novice.name: Novice

entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
entrepreneur.short: planning, deciding and applying competencies in practice

leader.description: Manages resources systematically, makes complex decisions, develops a team and a business, and shows stable strategic skills.

panel.howText: The stage summarises your current competency profile: the overall score of your latest assessment results (0–100). From {{min}} completed practical tasks with confirmed AI feedback, their average counts for {{weight}}%. Viewing lessons does not change the stage.
panel.preliminary: These are preliminary product thresholds (rules {{version}}), not a validated scale. The stage shows your current profile, not your worth as a person.
panel.noAssessmentText: Your character and development stage appear after the first full assessment. We don't guess a level before there are results.
panel.insufficientTitle: Not enough data for a stage yet
panel.insufficientText: Your results don't cover enough competencies with sufficient evidence to summarise them as a stage. A full reassessment fixes this.
panel.topStage: You are at the highest stage. Keep your results stable at the next reassessment.
panel.focus: work on {{name}}: it is your top priority gap.
panel.notWorth: The stage reflects your current competency profile, not your value as a person.
